summary: In this excerpt from a fiction serial (Book 15, part 177), Ray and Kilgore watch security monitors showing three large 'shed' creatures inside a sub-deck, which is far more dangerous than anticipated. The security panels turn red and Klaxons sound, prompting Becker to demand answers. Ray reports that the engineers appear dead and the shed have infiltrated the reactor cores, then patches the security images to Becker's terminals on Omicron.
one_line: Ray and Kilgore watch three giant shed invade a ship's reactor cores as alarms sound and Becker demands answers.
key_facts: Ray sees three shed on the monitor, and Kilgore remarks that they were not told the shed were so big.
Ray says he does not remember the shed being so big, though he admits they were big.
Kilgore estimates the largest shed at roughly thirty meters, a rough guess without something to scale against.
The security panels turn from green or yellow to red and a Klaxon buzz sounds throughout the ship.
Becker radios Ray, asking, "What is going on down there, Marlowe?"
Becker says all of the engineers are on that deck.
Ray replies, "Then all of the engineers appear to be dead."
Ray reports that the shed have infiltrated the reactor cores and that he is "way out of my depth here, Chief."
Ray gets Becker's sub-network id and patches images from the security station to remote terminals on Omicron.
Becker answers Ray's effort to show him the images with a barrage of silence.
The Klaxon alarm is compared to the staccato fire alarm bursts used for tornado drills at Ray's elementary school.
The shed are described as wandering the sub-deck architecture and ramming the engineering crew into satanic culinary designs.

entities.name: Ray Marlowe
entities.role: Protagonist who monitors the security screens and reports the shed attack to Becker (addressed as Marlowe)

entities.name: Kilgore

entities.name: Becker
entities.role: Chief who demands information over the network and receives Ray's report and images

entities.name: Omicron
entities.role: Location of the remote terminals to which the security images are patched

entities.name: shed
entities.role: Large creatures that have infiltrated the sub-deck and reactor cores
